claims.statement: Alarm lot measured 512.75 outside control limits 493.0-507.0 on DEP01-A
DEP01-A mean before PM is 503.911 vs 504.02 after with slope 0.101 showing no drift or shift
Prior lot on same chamber measured 501.55 at 70.8 h vs alarm 512.75 at 72.0 h showing isolated spike
FDC z-scores are -0.1 and 0.3 and -1.7 and 1.5 all normal with no heater or sensor shift
Re-measurement on MET01 gave 512.37 with range 10.69 confirming real film not a misread

disposition.summary: LOT-1239 is an isolated OOC wafer confirmed on re-measure with no chamber drift, PM shift, or FDC anomaly. Prior wafer on same chamber and clean was normal, indicating a one-off wafer. Lot can be released with no tool action.
